title: The behavior of red foxes
body: Red foxes hunt at dusk and cache food under leaves. They live alone for most of the year.

title: A winter walk with Vulpes vulpes
body: Researchers followed Vulpes vulpes across fresh snow and tracked its hunting trails.

title: Why wolves howl
body: Gray wolves howl to keep their pack together and mark territory across the forest.

title: Living with a family retriever
body: These friendly dogs love to fetch and need a long walk every day.

title: Bears before winter
body: Brown bears eat as much as they can in autumn to build fat for hibernation.

title: Deer at dawn
body: White-tailed deer feed in open grass at first light and watch for danger.

title: A stag in the autumn rut
body: A stag with large antlers calls out to rivals during the autumn breeding season.

title: Raising a gray puppy
body: A young puppy with blue eyes needs early training and a lot of patience.

title: Foxes and wolves compared
body: Foxes and wolves are both wild canines but differ in size and in how they hunt.

title: Life of the platypus
body: The platypus is a shy egg-laying mammal that lives in rivers in eastern Australia.

title: Why cats purr
body: A cat purrs when it is relaxed and sometimes when it is stressed or in pain.

title: Night hunters of the forest
body: An owl hunts silently at night using sharp hearing and soft feathers.

title: Grizzly bears fishing for salmon
body: Grizzly bears gather at rivers to catch salmon as the fish swim upstream.

title: A new puppy at home
body: A white puppy settles in on the deck and learns the first rules of the house.
